text: {"lessons":["Ten periods are still too little evidence to judge my strategy; I should avoid reacting to short-term market noise.","Selling some Stock D after a large gain reduced my exposure, but I should base future trades on portfolio risk and diversification, not the gain versus my average cost alone.","My losses feel especially painful, so I should set a tolerable risk level and review my holdings deliberately rather than let discomfort or inattention drive decisions."]}
